tasks.short: Insert control instructions and start operation

steps.what: Confirm control instructions match the approved programme and actual machine setup
Insert and verify control instructions in the machine control unit
Check readiness and start operation under the authorised proving procedure

tasks.design: Keep final instruction verification and start control with the operator at the {OTHER} machine controller. Existing loading functions remain in use; no new remote-start or unattended execution change is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The programme must match the actual machine, workholding and workpiece before operation begins.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controller facilities support loading but do not remove final readiness judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising discrepancies between a valid programme and an unsafe actual setup.
tasks.human_edge: Direct responsibility for readiness and controlled proving.
tasks.altitude: No change to start authority or verification time.

reach.task: Resolve a programme and setup mismatch before starting

evidence.claim: Siemens requires CAM output validation and simulation before execution; this supports retaining verification, not an automatic start capability.

assumptions: Boundary is final instruction loading and local start. No duplicate transfer saving is claimed against the programme-change task; a roll-up assigns shared loading once.

Authorised programming supplies the programme and revision. The operator checks controller identity, programme version, workholding and stock in fully retained s1; missing facts require manual clarification.
S3 includes positive time for final readiness and exact-start approval. Changed instructions or setup require renewed checks.
Zero upkeep because no new system or process is introduced; existing loading runtime is not human saving.
research_questions: Which discrepancies must block a start at the controller?

already_counted.description: Final readiness check and approval to start

approvals.approved_version: Exact controller programme version, machine, workpiece, workholding, tool setup and local start action; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+20+40=100; gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Loading verification and local start remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify and save programmes after operating problems

steps.what: Investigate operating problems and decide authorised cutting programme changes
Modify cutting programs using approved editing functions and correction parameters
Check modifications against specifications and simulation, then save the approved programme version

tasks.design: Use native parameter editing and programme comparison in the {OTHER} manufacturing programming system. The operator diagnoses the problem, specifies the correction and checks the exact revised version before saving; machine transfer and proving remain separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine edits can require repeated entry and manual comparison after the corrective decision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameter edits and version differences can reduce mechanical editing.
tasks.still_hard: Finding the true cause and avoiding a correction that creates a different machining problem.
tasks.human_edge: Interpreting actual cutting behaviour and judging whether a correction is appropriate.
tasks.altitude: Less routine editing; diagnosis and change authority remain human.

reach.task: Review an operating correction outside standard parameter limits

evidence.claim: NX CAM provides standard operations and requires validation before output runs; this supports assisted preparation with retained checks.
Native edit reuse and the specific savings estimate are E1 proposals.

assumptions: Boundary is problem-specific programme modification through saving, excluding general specification changes, machine transfer and first-piece proving. Overlapping editing time is assigned once.
The operator produces the problem description, current revision, affected operations, intended parameter changes, units and allowed limits in fully retained s1.
S2 includes parameter entry and manual edits within its 21 retained hours; no fault code or automatic corrective strategy is assumed. Unclear causes and nonstandard changes stay manual.
Test native editing and comparison first. Saving creates an approved file, not permission to execute it; local operator authority must be confirmed.
unknowns: Current editing tools and operator authority
research_questions: How much edit time can native parameter functions remove after retaining diagnosis and simulation?

already_counted.description: Parameter entry, edit checking and nonstandard correction work
Final validation and exact-version save approval

incremental.description: Maintain edit presets and version-comparison checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact modified file, part revision, correction brief, parameter values and simulation result; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+35*0.60+25=86; gross=14, upkeep=3, net=11. High assumes routine parameter edits; low assumes existing native tools already remove repeated work and only upkeep is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define simple programme requirements and choose approved operations and tooling
Write simple programs from selected operations and verified dimensions
Compare generated instructions with the specification, simulate and approve the saved programme

tasks.design: Configure approved operation templates and the machine-specific postprocessor in the {OTHER} manufacturing programming system. Generate only a simple draft from operator-selected operations and captured dimensions; retain specification comparison, simulation and exact-version approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Simple repeat programmes require repeated instruction entry after operations are chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Native operation templates can emit repeatable instructions without a language model.
tasks.still_hard: Template applicability, tool clearance, postprocessor behaviour and actual machine setup.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing feasible operations and recognising unsafe generated instructions.
tasks.altitude: Less routine instruction writing; no automatic machine execution.

reach.task: Validate a simple-programme template for an approved part family

evidence.claim: NX CAM recognises features and applies standard operations; this supports template-based draft preparation with validation.
The proposed deterministic scope and net savings are E1 estimates, not vendor programming-time claims.

assumptions: Boundary is simple programme writing through approval, excluding separate sequence-planning benefits, transfer and physical proving; a roll-up assigns common preparation once.

The operator produces part revision, dimensions, units, material, target machine, tools, selected operations and allowed parameters in fully retained s1. Engineering supplies the released drawing as an existing input.

S2 includes template selection, parameter capture checks and manual corrections in its 15.75 retained hours. Only approved operation patterns are generated; unsupported features return to manual programming.
Test native templates and postprocessors first. Existing automatic generation earns no additional saving; s3 retains all validation and approval time.
research_questions: What proportion of simple programmes fit validated templates after counting full specification capture and checks?

already_counted.description: Template fit, entry checks and draft corrections

incremental.description: Maintain templates, postprocessor versions and validation examples

approvals.approved_version: Exact generated programme, target machine, part revision, operation parameters, postprocessor and simulation snapshot; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+45*0.35+30=70.75; gross=29.25, upkeep=4, net=25.25. High assumes a repeat simple-part family; low assumes limited template fit leaves only 4 gross hours offsetting upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enter initial part dimensions into controls

steps.what: Verify initial part dimensions, units and coordinate references against the approved specification
Input the verified dimension set into the specified machine control panel
Verify controller readback against initial part dimensions before further operation

tasks.design: Test native parameter import at the {OTHER} machine controller using a verified dimension set. The operator approves the exact target and values before import and checks the readback afterwards; import cannot start a cycle.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified dimensions are repeatedly keyed into controller fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parameter import can remove repeat typing where the controller supports explicit field mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong units, datum, target or part revision can make consistent values unsafe.
tasks.human_edge: Checking dimensional intent against the actual setup.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated keying; verification and start authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm parameter mapping for an approved controller
reach.learn: Units, datums and controller field semantics

evidence.claim: Native parameter import and the labour-saving scenario are E1 proposals; the digest does not document this specific controller capability.

assumptions: Boundary covers dimension verification, input and readback, excluding measuring the part, tool offsets, programme editing and machine start. Overlapping data-entry benefits are assigned once.

The operator produces or verifies part revision, dimension names and values, units, datum, target controller and field mappings in fully retained s1. No structured dimension set is assumed without this capture.
S2 retains 12 hours for import selection, exact-value approval and exceptions. Missing or incompatible fields fall back to manual entry; s3 readback checking remains fully retained.
Test native import before custom integration. No live safety parameter, guard or cycle-start command is included.
research_questions: Does native import reduce time after producing the verified dimension set and checking readback?

already_counted.description: Exact import approval and manual entry exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain parameter mappings and controller-version checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact dimension set, part revision, units, datum, field mapping and target controller; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+40*0.30+20=72; gross=28, upkeep=3, net=25. High assumes repeated manual keying; low assumes import already exists or is unsupported and upkeep brings no gross benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
